pages.description: Winking with an open hand, Snow Miku wears a fluffy winter cape, star-patterned frilled skirt, and fur-trimmed boots. Surrounded by falling snowflakes and floating stars, this cheerful seasonal anime illustration makes a magical coloring page for kids using gel pens or soft colored pencils.
